reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend, skipsWeekendOccurrences and WEEKDAY_LOOKAHEAD in shared/schedules.ts, and passes holidays through every existing caller instead of adding parallel logic.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday test lives once in isNonWorkingDay, but getDatesInRange widens its search window with its own WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS + holidays.length next to the new getWeekdayLookahead.

placement.why: The new predicates sit in shared/schedules.ts beside the weekend helpers, and the server paths (getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) only pass holidays through.

scope.why: Every edit carries the holidays field through the type, the rule parser, the shared helpers and their callers.

maintainability.why: One predicate and one solver decide what counts as a non-working day; the rewritten WEEKEND_SHIFT_DAYS comment no longer matches the constant, and the window arithmetic is split between two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; every weekend check or move now goes through isNonWorkingDay or getDateWithSkippedWeekend with holidays

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts isNonWorkingDay (used by getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the daily skip filters) is used by getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template.ts
